test.title: Bus company — refunds and lost property

paragraphs.text: If a bus is more than 30 minutes late, passengers may claim a refund of the single fare within 14 days. Claims are made online; the ticket or a photograph of it must be attached.
Items left on a bus are kept at the depot for 28 days. Small items are returned free of charge; bicycles and pushchairs cost £10 to collect. The depot is open on weekdays only.
